agyos_skill.intent: Analyze cryptographic code to detect operations that leak secret data through execution timing variations.
agyos_skill.instructions: Analyze cryptographic code to detect operations that leak secret data through execution timing variations. ```text User writing crypto code? ──yes──> Use this skill │ no │ v User asking about timing attacks? ──yes──> Use this skill │ no │ v Code handles secret keys/tokens? ──yes──> Use this skill │ no │ v Skip this skill ``` **Concrete triggers:** - User implements signature, encryption, or key derivation - Code contains `/` or `%` operators on secret-derived values - User mentions "constant-time", "timing attack", "side-channel", "KyberSlash" - Reviewing functions named `sign`, `verify`, `encrypt`, `decrypt`, `derive_key` - Non-cryptographic code (business logic, UI, etc.)
